Name: A sack of hops
Notes: HE IS THE PRESSURE VALVE, and this is the row that proves it. tools/brewery_check.gd measures hops as the thing the Brewery runs out of - they only arrive when you WIN - so the Brewer sells them, dear. `Sells` is res:<id> for a Brewery material or brew:<id> for a recipe.

Name: A jar of live yeast
Notes: The other thing the cellar runs dry of.

Name: A tray of germs
Notes: The top of the chain. Cheapest of the three because it is the one you get most of from a fixture.

Name: A spare hammer
Notes: A TOOL, SO IT IS KEPT. You need one to work the Mill and you never need a second - which makes this row the one to look at if you ever lose one. Stock 1: he has exactly one.

Name: The fire recipe
Notes: SELLING A RECIPE rather than a material. brew:<id> unlocks that row of Brews.csv by name, exactly as a talent or an achievement would - the Pub can pour it from then on. Premium, because a talent point would have bought it for nothing.

Name: The water recipe
Notes: The same again for the cold side.

Name: Marsh-grown hops
Notes: PRICED IN MARKS, so only quick matches buy it - and it is the best hops deal in the game. That is what a second currency is FOR: it makes a mode worth playing rather than just available.

Name: A pair of iron-shod boots
Notes: THE FORGE MOVED HERE. The base used to have four one-click recipe buildings - the Forge, the Still, the Reed Press and the Cold Cellar - and they were worked examples rather than rooms you asked for. The recipe pattern is not lost: a Buildings.csv row with a Requires that is a price check and an Action that is the trade still works exactly as it did, and the Notes on the old rows are quoted in the Designer Manual. This is where Iron Boots comes from now, so the Iron Shod talent still has a door.

Name: A bottle of Fire Brew
Notes: ROUND AN (your note): the Traveling Merchant TRADES BEER for what you carried home. Sells count:brew_fire+1 = one Bottled Fire Brew (Items.csv) into your bag, used on a player in the draft. Price 3 Reed.

Name: A bottle of Water Brew
Notes: ROUND AN. One Bottled Water Brew for 2 Bog Iron.

Name: A Bottle of Water
Notes: ROUND AN (Anthony, 9 Oct): water is not free - only the Traveling Merchant sells it. MOOD -50|25: his price changes after every match, anywhere from half price (-50%) to a quarter more (+25%). Put a range on any row to make it moody; blank = a fixed price. 20 coins and unlimited stock are DRAFT numbers.
